fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) rose 2.7% in premarket trading, supported by sentiment recovery across the semiconductor industry following competitor Nvidia's earnings beat (revenue approximately $115.8 billion, EPS $2.68)
fields.summary_ko.1: AMD completed acquisition of AI inference chip designer Taalas for approximately $2.9 billion, strengthening its competitive position in the AI accelerator market dominated by Nvidia
